apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/LegacyH.fresh: Read once, before the shell starts, when the tab remembers no workspace.
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/LegacyH.why: It picks the workspace the tab opens on; from then on the workspace surface reads the same list and hears it (memberships, tenants).

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/zone.ts.fresh: Read only when the tab knows no zone yet; the workspace surface's read holds it after.
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/zone.ts.why: A day is counted in the workspace's zone, and a page asked for it before the workspace surface landed must not guess it; the surface's own read, heard, is what holds it afterwards.

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/activit.fresh: Read as Settings > Activity opens and as a filter changes, a page at a time; while it is open, its first page is read again each minute and as the tab comes back, and what is newer is offered above the lines (settings/activity/newer.ts).
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/activit.why: The log is the events table, which the feed never tells (every write in the workspace makes one); a minute's age is what an owner reading a log looks for, and newer lines wait for a press rather than move the lines they are reading (the wiring's second audit, X2-3).

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/activit.fresh: Asked as the owner types a name, a number or an address to filter the log by.
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/activit.why: A search answers what was typed at that moment and is asked again with the next key; nothing of it is kept or drawn after the pick.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/pro.fresh: Read as Settings > Profile opens, for the row How Ask answers you; the pane's own save sets what it draws.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/pro.why: The note is the member's own, in their membership's views: no teammate's change and no record of the workspace moves it, only their own save here or a card of theirs in Ask, which the row shows the next time the pane opens.

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.fresh: Read once the boot's reads are in, as Ask opens, after a follow-up card is committed or undone and after a question that comes back to one, each time Leads or Sequences publishes a read while one still waits (ask/follow-ups.ts), and as the tab comes back past a minute.
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.why: A follow-up is the member's own note in their views, changed only by their own cards and questions; what makes one due is a search's round ending or stopping to ask (which Leads hears), replies on a sequence (which Sequences hears), or the day turning, which a tab coming back catches.

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.fresh: Read as Ask's list of threads opens.
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.why: A member's threads with Ask are theirs alone, changed only by their own turns and deletes; no teammate's change and no record of the workspace moves them.

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.fresh: Read as a thread with Ask opens.
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.why: A thread with Ask is the member's own, changed only by their own turns, each of which answers with what it added.

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.fresh: Read when Ask is asked for the open times of a day and a service.
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/ask/api.why: It answers the question asked, about the calendar as it is then, and is asked again with the next question.

apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/platfor.fresh: Read as the back office opens, and kept for the tab (read-cache.ts).
apps/dashboard/src/legacy-bridge/platfor.why: The back office is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries; it is read again as it opens.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as the Admin log opens, a page at a time, and again as whose log it is changes.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as words are typed into Find, a pause after the last key.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as Health opens and when its window changes, and again after Run again or Deliver again.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0068).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as Home or Workspaces opens, and again after an act taken there.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as the Console opens: who is looking, their role and their second factor.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as Requests opens, and again after a request is filed or a step marked.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as Support opens, again as its view, kind, topic, workspace or words change, and after each of its presses.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as Health opens, and again after a bug report is moved back to Support.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0067).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as a workspace's Setup and lines tab opens in the Console, and again after a line's act; and as a row opens in Support, for its Setup's progress.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.fresh: Read as a workspace opens in the Console, and again after an act taken on it.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/console/verb.why: The Console is for the people who run Chanlytics and spans every workspace, which no workspace's topic carries (decision 0066).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/br.fresh: Read as a run's sheet opens, or a sequence's batch where its record draws it (History's day, a lead step's next email, the step editor's people: sequences/use-record.ts useBatchRead), or begun before it opens (the Inbox's run row, a link to a run landing by what it is), painted from the last answer and read again behind; then each time Sent's runs are read (the record: the Sequences list), while the run is underway and for the reply window after it ended (contracts runStillMoving).
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/br.why: What a run's report says moves with its sends, and with the replies, yeses and stops counted to it for 72 hours after it ends, each a record Sent's runs hear; a run that ended longer ago is history (the wiring's second audit, X2-2). Its delivery ticks are read with the next of those (R9).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.fresh: Read as a sequence's record opens, painted from the last answer and read again behind; then each time the Sequences list is read, and after each press on it.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.why: A sequence's steps, its notice and its head move with the sequence, its steps and its batches, each a record the list hears.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.fresh: Read as a sequence's History tab opens, painted from the last answer and read again behind; then each time the Sequences list is read, and after each press on it.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.why: What a sequence sent is its batches, which the list hears; a page further back is history and read as it is asked for.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.fresh: Read as a sequence's People tab opens, painted from the last answer and read again behind; then each time the Sequences list is read, and after each press on it.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.why: Where people stand moves with each batch and its sends; the list hears the batches, and a press on the tab reads it again.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.fresh: Read as a paused sequence's Turn on question opens, painted from the last answer and read again behind; then each time the Sequences list is read while the question stands.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.why: Who a run reaches is a count over everyone, which nothing heard in a moment moves enough to change a question asked and answered in seconds; Turn on itself is a write, which empties the tab's answers.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/pages/.fresh: Read as the Inbox opens on a sequence's replies (inbox/from:<id>, History's door), and again when the address names another sequence or period.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/pages/.why: It names which threads answered; the threads themselves are the Inbox surface's, heard as ever. A reply that comes in while it is open joins the filter when the door is pressed again, and the line says its count as read.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/held-t.fresh: Read inside the Inbox's and Today's own reads: the threads of open holds past the newest hundred, by their ids.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/held-t.why: It is part of two registered surfaces' reads (inbox/surface.ts, today/surface.ts), so it is read whenever they are, on every notice they hear.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/new-co.fresh: Asked as the owner types who to write to; with no words, the first page.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/new-co.why: A search answers what was typed at that moment and is asked again with the next key; the person picked is read on their own.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/new-co.fresh: Read as the new conversation's sheet opens on one person.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/new-co.why: How one person can be written to and called is asked for the message about to be sent, and the send door checks it again as it sends.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.fresh: A link the player fetches as it plays, signed afresh after a long pause.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.why: Nothing is drawn from it but the recording itself, which is made when it is fetched.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.fresh: A link to a call's transcript file, made when it is fetched.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.why: A file to keep, made when it is fetched: nothing on the page is drawn from it, so there is nothing to keep fresh.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.fresh: A link to a thread's transcript file, made when it is fetched.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.why: A file to keep, made when it is fetched: nothing on the page is drawn from it, so there is nothing to keep fresh.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/kit/media/tl.fresh: A link the browser fetches for an attachment as it is drawn.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/kit/media/tl.why: A message's attachment never changes once kept; the message it belongs to is what the page hears.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/leads/pile/b.fresh: Read as Leads' Back today opens, and again when a reach-out takes or gives back leads (the reach_out:leads event).
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/leads/pile/b.why: Who comes back today moves with the owner's own acts on the pile, which read it again; a teammate's reaches it on its next open.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/people/shell.fresh: A link to a list's file, made when it is fetched.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/people/shell.why: A file to keep, made when it is fetched: nothing on the page is drawn from it, so there is nothing to keep fresh.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/people/shell.fresh: A link to one person's own file (R14 X5), made when it is fetched.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/people/shell.why: A file to keep, made when it is fetched: nothing on the page is drawn from it, so there is nothing to keep fresh.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.fresh: The address the browser is sent to, to sign in with the mailbox's provider.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.why: A step away to the provider's own sign-in, not a read the page draws; the mailbox it connects is told by the feed (mailbox_connections).

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.fresh: Read as the business record's sheet opens.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.why: The record the carriers read is filled in on this sheet; Setup and Connections hear its saves on the feed (business_records), and the sheet reads it again as it opens.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.fresh: Read as WhatsApp's connect sheet opens.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.why: It says whether this deployment can connect a number and by whom: Meta's door as configured, which changes with a deploy, not with a record.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.fresh: Read each time the codes are shown: the edge reads them from the provider's own record on every call.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.why: A code sent to the line lately is the provider's, read fresh on every ask, and kept by nobody here.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/fra.fresh: A link to the workspace's file, made when it is fetched.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/fra.why: A file to keep, made when it is fetched: nothing on the page is drawn from it, so there is nothing to keep fresh.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/bus.fresh: Read every two seconds while its call runs, and once more as it ends (decision 0069).
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/bus.why: A rehearsal is the owner's own call, three minutes at most, and only the Rehearse card that started it draws it: no other page reads one, so no feed has to tell anyone about it.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.fresh: Read as a draft's step sheet previews a lead in it, one lead at a time as ‹ › reaches it, and kept for the tab.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.why: Preview shows a step as that lead gets it, filled from the lead's own record; a lead's name, city and listing change seldom, and the send itself fills each email from the record as it stands when it goes, never from this read.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.fresh: Read as a lead's sheet opens (on Leads, or over a record), and again after each of the sheet's own presses (its moved), kept for the tab while it is open.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.why: Where a lead stands moves by a press, which the sheet reads again after, or by the sequence's own run; the record's Leads tab, a heard surface, files the same rows from the same reader (00459 sequence_places), so the two windows never disagree for long.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.fresh: Read as Leads opens on a search (the pick, Adds go to) and as a lead's picker opens, and again after a sequence is made or a lead added from the sheet or the bar.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/se.why: It names the sequences to leads Add can go to and the pick's state; a sequence made or started elsewhere shows in the picker the next time it opens, and the add door itself refuses one that ended, in words, so nothing is added on a stale read.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/leads/sheet/.fresh: Read as a lead's sheet opens over another page by its address (?lead=, a record's Leads row), once for that lead.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/leads/sheet/.why: The sheet over a record is a look at one lead from where its row was pressed; its place is the sheet's own read, read again after each press, and closing and opening the row reads the lead afresh.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/pages/.fresh: Asked a beat after the last key in Conversations' box, for the calls whose stored transcript says the box's words; asked again for each new words, never kept.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/pages/.why: A list's ended calls come without their turns (GET calls answers how many there were), so the box asks the server for the calls that say its words; the answer is a search's, as the box's other matches are, and is gone when the words change.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.fresh: Read once, by the call's id, as its card opens on a call a list gave without its turns; kept for the tab.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/inbox/thread.why: An ended call's words do not change, and everything else about the call stays the Conversations surface's, which hears the calls table.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/re.fresh: Read as a chain's row opens on Campaigns, the last answer kept on screen while it is read again; then, while it is open, at most every 30 seconds as Leads or the reach-outs publish a read (row.tsx useReachOutReport over read-again.ts).
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/re.why: A chain's report counts what its runs wrote and what came back, each a record the reach-outs surface hears (a run made, approved or sent, a reply read or undone, a chain paused); the window keeps a lead run's batches from reading it again on every one.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/re.fresh: Read as a sequence's runs sheet opens (sequences/leads/runs-sheet.tsx), painted first from this tab's last answer for that list (read-cache.ts).
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/re.why: It says how many of the list's leads wait on an address to be confirmed, one line beside the sheet's choice; the sheet is open for the moment a choice takes, and its next opening reads it again.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/re.fresh: Read as New message's Write to leads opens, and again by its retry after a read that failed (sources.tsx).
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/campaigns/re.why: What a reach-out can start from is each search or list with someone to write to and no sequence yet; the choice is open for the moment a pick takes, and a search that gains leads meanwhile is there the next time Write to leads opens.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/reports/lens.fresh: Read once the Campaigns lens's picker is reached for (a pointer over it, its focus, a press), and held while the page stays.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/reports/lens.why: It is the list of campaigns the picker offers; a sequence made while the page is open is offered after a reload, and the one the address names is listed whatever the list says.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/reports/lens.fresh: Read as Reports › Campaigns opens on one campaign, and again as its days or its campaign change or Retry is pressed.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/reports/lens.why: Its name, its steps and its clock, which change rarely; the cards say what it sent, not what it is about to do.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/reports/lens.fresh: Read with the record, a page at a time back to the first day shown, and again as the days or the campaign change or Retry is pressed.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/reports/lens.why: A report of days that went: a send that lands while it is open is counted at the next read, as Reports' other lenses are read for the period picked.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/today/need-y.fresh: Read as Today's Need you draws its rows, and again whenever the threads it draws or the newest message on one of them changes (useDraftsAhead's key, pages/queue.tsx), so a draft for an older message is asked for again.
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/today/need-y.why: A kept draft is words nothing sends: it is read for the rows on screen, and a Send goes through the reply's own door with whatever words the row holds by then; the feed moves the rows, and the rows ask again.

apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.fresh: Read on the owner's press (Show who), and again after each of its own presses (It's a person, Undo).
apps/dashboard/src/surfaces/settings/con.why: A list to act on in the moment: the mailbox adds to it as mail arrives, which the next press reads; nothing else on the page is drawn from it, and it is never kept.
